notes: Block Main-Sycamore, 5th-4th. An unnamed 10' alley (printed only ALLEY) runs N-S through the block from 5th to 4th at x~1872-1880, widening slightly south of y~2150. West of Main the 5th St line is GOVERNMENT SQ. (130', faces y~1446 and ~1896, axis y~1671) while E 5th east of Main is 66' (faces 1446-1672, axis y~1558); north faces align, so two T's on Main. Government Place (sheet 120) enters Main from the west at y~2354 (20 ft). HAMMOND (40 ft, faces x~1952-2095, sheet 117) enters 4th from the south. Points read from block corners, not from the water-pipe lines. Beside the alley, in the 4th St half, a pasted label reads 'R.A. LAWSON' next to '6" W.P.'; it may be an alley name (Lawson Alley?) but is not clearly one, so the alley is left unnamed.
